title: Greek Spinach and Feta Omelette
summary: A quick, savoury omelette with tender spinach, salty feta and a touch of herbs. It makes a light Greek-style breakfast that’s ready in minutes.
steps: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add the oregano, salt and black pepper, then beat until well combined.
Heat the olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Add the red onion and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until softened.
Add the spinach and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring, until wilted and any excess moisture has cooked off.
Pour the eggs into the pan and tilt it so they spread evenly. Cook gently for 2 to 3 minutes until the base is set and the top is still slightly soft.
Scatter the feta over one half of the omelette, then fold the other half over and cook for 30 seconds to 1 minute more until just set.
Slide onto a plate and serve immediately while hot and fluffy.
